name: partner-team-fleet-connection
executionConcern: partner Store team lifecycle and one-time-code courier fleet connection shared with Captains and operator readback
objective: Make Partner team and courier connection lifecycle use one DSH Store-scoped, versioned, idempotent and audited truth from invitation through code issue/revoke/redeem/disconnect, with redacted operator and Captain readback.
truthOwner: DSH Store-team and Partner-fleet domains; Identity authenticates actors but does not own fleet membership.
journeys: Partner team invitation and member action

tasks.objective: Unify Partner team and fleet membership lifecycle at DSH
tasks.currentProblem: Static team guards and route bindings do not prove Store-team/fleet membership, one-time-code concurrency and cross-surface readback cannot diverge.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace invitation/member actions and fleet issue/revoke/redeem/disconnect through contracts, DSH transactions, constraints/versioning/audit and affected surfaces; remove any parallel membership truth.
tasks.targetState: One Store-scoped DSH membership lifecycle is authoritative, idempotent, auditable and redacted for each consumer.
tasks.action: Correct DSH owner/invariants first, then migrate Partner/Captain/operator consumers and rerun linked checks.
mustNotChange: Do not persist plaintext connection codes.
Do not create local fleet membership truth.
acceptanceCriteria: Invitation/membership and fleet connection are Store-scoped and auditable.
One-time codes are non-replayable/revocable and concurrent safe.
Partner/Captain/operator readback converges with required redaction.
tasks.rollback: Revert focused fleet/team changes or roll forward at DSH while preserving audit/membership data.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U004 commit after DSH membership truth and all three consumers align.

tasks.objective: Close secret, replay and disconnect recovery behavior
tasks.currentProblem: A successful UI mutation does not prove expired/revoked/replayed code or disconnect/reconnect behavior under concurrency.
tasks.requiredChange: Add/repair negative paths, version checks, audit and redacted readback for issue/revoke/redeem/disconnect.
tasks.targetState: Expired/revoked/replayed codes fail closed; membership changes persist after refresh and never disclose secrets.
tasks.action: Change only Partner-fleet/team paths and security controls proven by current Product Truth.
mustNotChange: Do not expose operator-only audit to Partner/Captain.
acceptanceCriteria: No plaintext credential appears in persistence/logs.
tasks.rollback: Revert focused changes while retaining secure canonical membership data.
